title: The nightly load now finishes before the analysts start
cover: On staging, the nightly load now finishes before the analysts start.
chapters: Each night the load read every file
A fingerprint shows which files changed
A new file format still costs a night
Where it stands, and what I need
notes: An invented example. The file contents, read times and start time are made up, and values.py computes the rest.

clicks.change: The season's 40 files appear, all outlined as read
clicks.caption: Each night the load read all 40 files of the season.

clicks.change: A time line appears with the finish marker at 08:50, past the analysts' start
clicks.caption: So it finished at 08:50, after the analysts start.
How many of these do you think changed since last night?
Take one file that has not changed, number 24.

clicks.change: The file round-24.csv comes out of its tile and glides beside the grid
Tonight's fingerprint of it appears below
clicks.caption: A fingerprint is a short code computed from the file's contents.

clicks.change: Last night's fingerprint appears below it with an equals sign, the same code
clicks.caption: Last night's fingerprint is the same.

clicks.change: Tile 24 turns dashed and struck through, skipped
clicks.caption: So file 24 is skipped tonight.

clicks.change: Every unchanged file turns skipped, the three changed ones outlined as read
clicks.caption: Only the files whose fingerprint changed are read.

clicks.change: The finish marker slides from 08:50 to 05:49, leaving a faint marker at 08:50
clicks.caption: That's over an hour before the analysts start.
A new file format changes every fingerprint at once.

clicks.change: The finish marker slides from 05:49 to 08:54, leaving a faint marker at 05:49
clicks.caption: That night it finishes at 08:54, as late as before.

clicks.change: A line appears saying it finishes by 05:49 on staging
